caption: The video captures a dance studio with a large mirrored wall, sheer white curtains at the left, gray drapes and a wall-mounted air conditioner at the right, and a glossy reflective floor. A single woman in a blue star-decorated top, a flared yellow skirt, and tan high-heeled dance shoes stands before the mirror with her arms crossed over her chest. Several mirror images of her, in side and back views, line the wall. They move in lockstep with her body. The camera stays fixed while she performs an in-place rotation. Her crossed-arm posture is held continuously; the change lies in torso and head orientation. She turns her upper body gradually, rotating her head so more of her front and side face the camera and her face becomes visible in the leftmost view. At the same time her feet move from a spread, flat-heel stance to a position where one heel lifts and that foot pivots onto the ball—a slow weight transfer rather than a step. The yellow skirt sways and flares slightly with the rotation. Her knees and ankles make small adjustments, while every mirrored image tracks these movements exactly.
